author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a diagonal claw hammer with a long round-ended handle, a flat face and a curved claw, and a T nail at the bottom right; reads as hammer and nail like the reference. The rejected drawing was a blocky hammer. A first layout had a stubby handle; the handle axis was moved to reach the bottom-left corner.
omissions: The nail head is a flat line (T) instead of a small outlined pill; the neck between head and face is not drawn.
drawing_plan: SQUARE on the 45-degree grid: head between x-y=7 and 19, face on x+y=61, claw end x+y=35 with a bezier claw (tip (14,15), crest (20,6)); handle tube x+y=41..55 with r5 cap at (11,37); nail head y 36 (x 34..42), shank to 42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'hammer': diagonal handle with a perpendicular head and claw.
